caseStudies.title: Smart School Security Integration
caseStudies.challenge: Amity University campus main gate was suffering from excessive tailgating, unauthorized visitors, and manual attendance registration which took up to 30 minutes per class.
caseStudies.solution: We deployed real-time Face Recognition access gates across 4 state-university campus main gates, reducing unauthorized tailgating incidents and automating attendance logs.
caseStudies.results: Reduced unauthorized tailgating incidents by 98.4% and automated attendance logs, reducing register overhead from 30 minutes to less than 2 seconds.

downloads.label: Amity University Success Story Spec Sheet

testimonial.quote: The NX Solution smart biometric system has completely changed our campus safety. Attendance takes seconds, and we have real-time alerts for any unregistered personnel.
testimonial.author: Dr. K. S. Sharma

caseStudies.title: Hospital Patient Safety and Tracking
caseStudies.challenge: Alzheimer patients and high-risk visitors frequently wandered near hazardous or restricted pharmaceutical zones without authorized guides.
caseStudies.solution: Integrated smart CCTV cameras with NX Sentinel software to alert staff instantly when Alzheimer patients enter unauthorized high-risk wards or wander near perimeter boundaries.
caseStudies.results: Wandering incidents into restricted zones reduced to absolute zero, and emergency dispatch alerts dropped from 5 minutes to under 15 seconds.

testimonial.quote: NX Sentinel's patient tracking module acts like an invisible guardian. It lets our nurses focus on clinical care while keeping vulnerable patients safe.
testimonial.author: Sister Clara D'Souza

seo.keywords: hospital patient tracking, ward security, nursing alerts AI

caseStudies.title: Factory Safety Automation
caseStudies.challenge: Factory floor workers frequently entered heavy conveyor hazard-zones without complete PPE gear, risking severe safety violations and accidents.
caseStudies.solution: Utilized deep-learning image processing to automatically stop dangerous factory conveyors if a floor worker enters the hazard-zone without complete PPE gear (Helmet/Vest).
caseStudies.results: Zero industrial safety accidents since deployment, and complete compliance tracking for OSHA regulatory audits.

testimonial.quote: Our factory had several safety close-shaves. This automated NPU conveyor shutoff system literally saves lives and keeps us fully compliant with regulations.
testimonial.author: Vikram Malhotra

seo.keywords: PPE detection AI, conveyor automatic stop, manufacturing safety

caseStudies.author: AI Specialist Rahul Verma

caseStudies.title: Smart Society Integrated Security
caseStudies.challenge: Manual gate verification for 1,200+ residential families created long queues at rush hours, and allowed unauthorized delivery vehicles to enter unlogged.
caseStudies.solution: Launched an automated smart barrier solution coupled with license plate validation algorithms for a residential luxury township housing 1,200+ active families.
caseStudies.results: Peak hours traffic congestion cleared, and visitor registration automated by 94% with secure app logs.

testimonial.quote: The automated license plate reader has removed the gate block completely. Now delivery agents get one-time PINs and residents feel 100% safe.
testimonial.author: Sanjay Singhal
